description: This source file defines the CLI command for connecting to a gateway in the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes option parsing, connection logic, and output formatting for the 'connect' command, as well as related data structures and actor for managing snapshots.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: Defines the set of options/flags for the connect command, with a static parse method to process command-line arguments.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: Encapsulates the output data for the connect command, including status, URL, role, snapshot, health, and error information.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor that holds a snapshot (`HelloOk?`) with thread-safe set and get methods.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Asynchronous function orchestrating the connect process, including option parsing, connection attempt, and output display.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Outputs the connection result in either JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the gateway endpoint URL, token, and password based on options and configuration.
